verdict.description: Final review verdict: 'pass' when all quality bar criteria and validations pass, 'fail' otherwise.

largest_remaining_gap.description: One precise, highest-impact unresolved defect. Empty string if verdict is pass.

severity.description: Severity rating of the largest remaining gap. Must be 'none' if verdict is pass.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence strings from the diff, tests, lint, or workflow output.

quality_bar_failures.description: List of quality-bar criteria numbers (1 through 12) that failed.

required_next_action.description: The smallest actionable step needed to close the largest remaining gap.
